# Pet Bowl Size Calculator (by PawsOnMe)

> Free calculator for how high and how big a dog's or cat's food bowl should be, from the pet's elbow height, meal size and needs. Each number is labelled as a study result or a rule of thumb, with sources. Made by PawsOnMe, an Etsy shop of ceramic slow feeder bowls for cats and small to medium dogs: https://www.etsy.com/shop/PawsOnMePet

## Key answers
- Dog bowl height: rim between elbow height and 5 to 7.5 cm (2 to 3 in) below it. Rule of thumb; no veterinary guideline sets a height.
- Large and giant breed dogs: height matters. In a cohort of 1,637 dogs, large breeds (23 to 45 kg) fed from a bowl raised 1 ft (30.5 cm) or less had 3.06 times the bloat (GDV) risk of floor-fed dogs, with no significant difference above 1 ft; giant breeds (over 45 kg) had 2.29 times the risk above 1 ft and no significant difference at 1 ft or less (Glickman et al., JAVMA 2000; Buckley, Veterinary Evidence 2017). So a raised bowl goes above 30.5 cm for a large breed and at 30.5 cm or lower for a giant breed. One study with 98 bloat cases; an internet survey found no clear effect of bowl height (Pipan et al., JAVMA 2012). Dogs with megaesophagus are fed from a raised position on purpose: front legs higher than back legs, then upright for at least 10 to 15 minutes after meals (Merck Veterinary Manual).
- Cats: most eat fine from the floor. Whisker-friendly dishes made no difference to eating in a 38-cat study, though 63% of owners said their cat preferred them (Slovak and Foster, JFMS 2021).
- Capacity: 1.5 times the meal volume, 2 times for a slow feeder. 1 US cup = 236.6 ml. Rule of thumb. For grams, divide grams per meal by the grams in one cup of that food first.
- How much to feed: resting energy = 70 x (weight in kg)^0.75 kcal a day; multiply by 1.6 for a spayed or neutered adult dog, 1.2 for a spayed or neutered adult cat, 2 to 3 for puppies and kittens (Pet Nutrition Alliance). Divide by kcal per cup on the bag (or by kcal per kg × 1,000 for grams); adjust to body condition.
- What to feed: a food labelled complete and balanced for the life stage; puppies that will be large dogs need a growth food that includes large size dogs.
- Slow feeders lowered eating speed in a small study of 10 pet dogs. No trial shows they prevent bloat.

## Second skill
- Low-fat and copper-restricted diet math for dogs (skills/dog-diet-fat-copper): RER = 70 x kg^0.75; fat line 24 g per 1000 kcal (Today's Veterinary Practice), AAFCO fat minimum 13.8 g per 1000 kcal; copper target for copper-associated hepatopathy < 1.2 mg per 1000 kcal (Today's Veterinary Practice 2025), AAFCO copper minimum 1.83 mg per 1000 kcal.
